items.raw_excerpt: A Timmins building will soon bear the name of a long-time city politician and well-known local personality. Drew McMillin reports.
items.summary_en: A building in Timmins, Ontario will soon be renamed to honour Michael Doody, a long-time city politician and well-known local figure. The museum will carry his name as a tribute to his years of public service. The announcement was made by CTV News Northern Ontario.

items.title_en: Timmins museum to be named after long-time politician Michael Doody

items.raw_excerpt: El Ayuntamiento de Sempere dictó un bando con el apoyo del PP para respaldar las concentraciones en apoyo a la ciudad autónoma
items.summary_en: The mayor of Sempere, a village of just 33 people and the smallest town in Valencia province, issued a public statement supporting solidarity gatherings for Ceuta. She broke ranks with her party leader Pedro Sanchez over the crisis in the autonomous city. Even with no room for an in-person rally, the tiny town made its voice heard.
items.summary_ko: 스페인 발렌시아 주에서 가장 작은 마을 셈페레의 시장은 인구 33명에 불과한 마을 대표로 세우타 연대 집회를 지지하는 공식 성명을 발표했다. 그녀는 세우타 위기에 대해 소속 정당 대표인 페드로 산체스와 노선 차이를 보였다. 직접 집회를 열 공간은 없었지만, 작은 마을도 목소리를 냈다.
items.title_en: Mayor of Spain's Smallest Village Backs Ceuta Protest
items.title_ko: 스페인에서 가장 작은 마을의 시장, 세우타 지지 성명 발표
items.title_original: La alcaldesa socialista del pueblo más pequeño de Valencia se desmarca de Sánchez por la crisis en Ceuta - El Debate

items.summary_en: Residents of Lachówka, a tiny village near Siemiatycze, organized a grassroots memorial to honor their forefathers. The initiative started among neighbors and grew into a community event bringing people together around shared local history. Organizers said no grand ceremony was needed, just a shared desire to preserve the stories of their village.
items.summary_ko: 시에미아티체 근처 소도시 라호프카 주민들이 선조를 기리기 위한 자발적 기념 행사를 열었다. 이웃들 사이에서 시작된 이 행사는 지역 역사를 공유하며 마을 사람들을 하나로 모으는 자리가 되었다. 주최측은 화려한 의식이 필요 없었으며, 단지 마을의 이야기를 지키고 싶다는 마음만 있으면 충분했다고 전했다.
items.title_en: Small Polish village gathers to honor ancestors and keep local memory alive

items.raw_excerpt: The flu season is yet to peak, and under-fives continue to bear the brunt, latest data shows.
items.summary_en: New Zealand flu season has not yet reached its peak. Hospital admissions for children under five are rising quickly. Health officials say young kids are the most affected group.

items.title_en: Flu Season Hits Young Children Hard in New Zealand

items.title_original: Under-fives continue to bear brunt of flu season, as hospitalisations go off the charts

items.raw_excerpt: Sie ist 33 Jahre alt und kämpft mit Leidenschaft für Klimagerechtigkeit und Inklusion, gegen Patriarchat und Kapitalismus. Doch nun muss sich Jelena Filipovic (Grünes Bündnis) ein Jahr lang zurückhalten: Am Donnerstag wird sie zur «höchsten Bernerin» gewählt.
items.summary_en: Jelena Filipovic, a 33-year-old climate justice activist, has been elected as the honorary head of Bern. She is a member of the Green Alliance and advocates for inclusion and social justice. The ceremonial role is traditionally held for one year.
items.summary_ko: 기후 정의 활동가인 33세 예레나 필리포비치가 베른의 명예 수장으로 선출되었습니다. 그녀는 녹색 동맹 소속으로 포용과 사회 정의를 위해 활동하고 있습니다. 이 의전 직책은 전통적으로 1년간 유지됩니다.
items.title_en: Left-leaning migrant Jelena Filipovic elected as honorary head of Bern
